rationale: The change alters the interface supplying obstacle information to the Observable Representation, while the Evaluation Target, Phenomenon of Interest, object-category scheme, and spatial-relation basis remain unchanged. In the baseline, H1-ORR1 depends on H1-A1, whose revalidation condition H1-RC1 is triggered by changes to the obstacle-detection requirements, architectural responsibility for obstacle information, or the information supplied for representing obstacle presence. The change directly intersects that dependency, so only H1-ORR1 must be revalidated.
